name: table
description: Text columns and rows with optional status text. Columns must not be empty. Each row has one cell per column. Each status is in status_values. The sort key is a zero-based column index. Sort direction needs a sort key. Equal cells keep their input order. A new fill resets the sort.

parts.name: authorship
parts.description: Type and ID of the author, with a name when available.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: empty
parts.description: Message that shows when there are no items.

parts.name: reason
parts.description: Reason for a refusal or an edit error.

parts.name: sort-status
parts.description: Text that gives the sort column and direction.

parts.name: table
parts.description: Scroll area that contains the table.
